senses.ex: Drinking too much alcohol can damage your liver.
senses.exPt: Beber álcool demais pode prejudicar o fígado.

senses.def: alive now
senses.ex: Plants and animals are living things.
senses.exPt: Plantas e animais são seres vivos.

senses.def: the main room in a house where people sit and relax
senses.ex: The kids are watching TV in the living room.
senses.exPt: As crianças estão vendo TV na sala de estar.

senses.def: something heavy that is carried by a person, animal or vehicle
senses.ex: The truck was carrying a heavy load.
senses.exPt: O caminhão levava uma carga pesada.

senses.def: to put things into a vehicle or machine
senses.ex: Can you help me load the car?
senses.exPt: Você me ajuda a carregar o carro?

senses.def: a lot of something
senses.ex: Don't hurry, we have loads of time.
senses.exPt: Não precisa correr, temos um monte de tempo.

senses.def: bread baked in one large piece
senses.ex: I bought a loaf of bread for breakfast.
senses.exPt: Comprei um pão de forma para o café da manhã.

senses.def: in or from the area near you
senses.ex: We buy our bread at the local bakery.
senses.exPt: Compramos pão na padaria do bairro.

senses.def: to be in a particular place (be located)
senses.ex: The hotel is located near the beach.
senses.exPt: O hotel fica perto da praia.

senses.def: to find the exact position of someone or something
senses.ex: The police were unable to locate the stolen car.
senses.exPt: A polícia não conseguiu localizar o carro roubado.

senses.def: a place or position
senses.ex: The hotel is in a perfect location near the beach.
senses.exPt: O hotel tem uma localização perfeita perto da praia.

senses.def: to close a door or box with a key
senses.ex: Did you lock the front door?
senses.exPt: Você trancou a porta da frente?

senses.def: the part of a door or drawer that you open and close with a key
senses.ex: I heard the key turn in the lock.
senses.exPt: Ouvi a chave girar na fechadura.

senses.def: a metal object with a key or code used to lock something
senses.ex: I need a lock for my bike.
senses.exPt: Preciso de um cadeado para a minha bicicleta.

senses.def: a small house in the countryside used for holidays or sports
senses.ex: We stayed at a ski lodge in the mountains.
senses.exPt: Ficamos num chalé de esqui nas montanhas.

senses.def: log in/on: to type your name and password to start using a computer or website
senses.ex: You need a password to log in to the website.
senses.exPt: Você precisa de uma senha para entrar no site.

senses.def: a thick piece of wood cut from a tree
senses.ex: He put another log on the fire.
senses.exPt: Ele colocou mais um tronco na fogueira.

senses.def: an official written record of events
senses.ex: The captain kept a log of the journey.
senses.exPt: O capitão mantinha um registro da viagem.

senses.def: a sensible way of thinking or reasoning
senses.ex: I don't understand the logic behind this decision.
senses.exPt: Não entendo a lógica por trás dessa decisão.

senses.def: reasonable and making sense
senses.ex: That is the most logical answer.
senses.exPt: Essa é a resposta mais lógica.

senses.def: a design or symbol that a company uses
senses.ex: The company changed its logo last year.
senses.exPt: A empresa mudou o logotipo no ano passado.

senses.def: unhappy because you are alone or have no friends
senses.ex: She felt lonely when she moved to a new city.
senses.exPt: Ela se sentiu sozinha quando se mudou para uma cidade nova.

senses.def: measuring a big distance from one end to the other
senses.ex: She has long dark hair.
senses.exPt: Ela tem cabelo comprido e escuro.

senses.def: lasting a lot of time
senses.ex: It was a long day at work.
senses.exPt: Foi um dia longo no trabalho.

senses.def: to turn your eyes towards something
senses.ex: Look at this photo of my dog!
senses.exPt: Olha essa foto do meu cachorro!

senses.def: to seem to be something
senses.ex: You look tired today.
senses.exPt: Você parece cansado hoje.

senses.def: the act of looking at something
senses.ex: Can I have a look at your new phone?
senses.exPt: Posso dar uma olhada no seu celular novo?

senses.def: not firmly fixed in place
senses.ex: One of the screws on the chair is loose.
senses.exPt: Um dos parafusos da cadeira está frouxo.

senses.def: not fitting the body tightly
senses.ex: She likes to wear loose clothes in summer.
senses.exPt: Ela gosta de usar roupas folgadas no verão.

senses.def: free, not tied up or kept in a place
senses.ex: The dog is loose in the garden again.
senses.exPt: O cachorro está solto no quintal de novo.

senses.def: a large vehicle for carrying goods by road
senses.ex: The road was blocked by a lorry carrying sand.
senses.exPt: A estrada estava bloqueada por um caminhão carregado de areia.

senses.def: to not be able to find something, or to not win
senses.ex: I always lose my keys.
senses.exPt: Eu sempre perco minhas chaves.

senses.def: the fact of no longer having something or someone
senses.ex: The loss of his job was a big shock.
senses.exPt: A perda do emprego foi um grande choque para ele.

senses.def: money that a business loses
senses.ex: The company made a loss last year.
senses.exPt: A empresa teve prejuízo no ano passado.

senses.def: not knowing where you are, or not able to be found
senses.ex: Excuse me, I think we're lost.
senses.exPt: Com licença, acho que estamos perdidos.

senses.def: a lot: a large amount or number
senses.ex: We have a lot of homework today.
senses.exPt: Temos muito dever de casa hoje.

senses.def: a game where people buy tickets and win money if their numbers are chosen
senses.ex: If I win the lottery, I'll buy a house by the sea.
senses.exPt: Se eu ganhar na loteria, vou comprar uma casa na praia.

senses.def: making a lot of sound
senses.ex: The music is too loud, I can't hear you.
senses.exPt: A música está alta demais, não consigo te ouvir.

senses.def: of people or places: making a lot of noise
senses.ex: Our new neighbours are really loud.
senses.exPt: Nossos novos vizinhos são muito barulhentos.

senses.def: out loud: so that other people can hear
senses.ex: Can you read the letter out loud?
senses.exPt: Você pode ler a carta em voz alta?

senses.def: in a way that makes a lot of noise
senses.ex: Please don't talk so loudly in the library.
senses.exPt: Por favor, não fale tão alto na biblioteca.

senses.def: a piece of equipment that makes sounds louder
senses.ex: They announced the delay over the loudspeaker.
senses.exPt: Eles anunciaram o atraso pelo alto-falante.

senses.def: to have very strong feelings for someone
senses.ex: She loves her children very much.
senses.exPt: Ela ama muito os filhos.

senses.def: to like something very much
senses.ex: I love pizza with lots of cheese.
senses.exPt: Eu adoro pizza com bastante queijo.

senses.def: a very strong feeling of liking someone
senses.ex: Their love grew stronger every year.
senses.exPt: O amor deles ficou mais forte a cada ano.

senses.def: very beautiful or attractive
senses.ex: What a lovely dress! Where did you buy it?
senses.exPt: Que vestido lindo! Onde você comprou?

senses.def: very pleasant or enjoyable
senses.ex: It was a lovely day at the beach.
senses.exPt: Foi um dia ótimo na praia.

senses.def: kind and friendly
senses.ex: Your mother is a lovely person.
senses.exPt: Sua mãe é uma pessoa muito querida.

senses.def: a person who enjoys something very much
senses.ex: My dad is a big music lover.
senses.exPt: Meu pai é um grande amante de música.

senses.def: in a way that shows love or great care
senses.ex: She looked lovingly at the baby in her arms.
senses.exPt: Ela olhou carinhosamente para o bebê em seus braços.

senses.def: not high, or less than usual in amount
senses.ex: The prices in this shop are very low.
senses.exPt: Os preços desta loja são muito baixos.

senses.def: almost finished, used about a battery
senses.ex: My phone battery is low, can I charge it here?
senses.exPt: A bateria do meu celular está fraca, posso carregar aqui?

senses.def: always supporting a person, team or company
senses.ex: Dogs are very loyal to their owners.
senses.exPt: Os cachorros são muito leais aos donos.

senses.def: the quality of always supporting a person or group
senses.ex: Dogs are famous for their loyalty to their owners.
senses.exPt: Os cães são famosos pela lealdade aos donos.

senses.def: good things that happen by chance
senses.ex: Good luck on your exam tomorrow!
senses.exPt: Boa sorte na prova amanhã!

senses.def: used to say that something good happened by chance
senses.ex: Luckily, nobody was hurt in the accident.
senses.exPt: Felizmente, ninguém se machucou no acidente.

senses.def: having good things happen to you by chance
senses.ex: You won again? You're so lucky!
senses.exPt: Você ganhou de novo? Você é muito sortudo!

senses.def: bringing good luck
senses.ex: Seven has always been my lucky number.
senses.exPt: Sete sempre foi o meu número da sorte.

senses.def: the bags and suitcases you take when you travel
senses.ex: How much luggage are you taking on the trip?
senses.exPt: Quanta bagagem você vai levar na viagem?

senses.def: the meal you eat in the middle of the day
senses.ex: What do you want for lunch today?
senses.exPt: O que você quer de almoço hoje?

senses.def: the time in the middle of the day when people eat lunch
senses.ex: I'll call you at lunchtime.
senses.exPt: Eu te ligo na hora do almoço.

senses.def: one of the two organs in your chest used for breathing
senses.ex: Smoking can cause serious damage to your lungs.
senses.exPt: Fumar pode causar danos graves aos pulmões.

senses.def: great comfort that costs a lot of money
senses.ex: They stayed in a luxury hotel by the beach.
senses.exPt: Eles ficaram num hotel de luxo perto da praia.

senses.def: the words of a song
senses.ex: I don't know the lyrics of this song.
senses.exPt: Eu não sei a letra desta música.
